dedupe_keys.name: ngpl india network provenance separated reconstruction of india s authorised natural gas transmission pipelines pngrb register 2025

description: ngpl-india-network is a machine-readable reconstruction of India's authorised natural gas transmission network built from the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board register of Natural Gas Pipeline Networks dated 31 December 2025. It covers 99 authorised pipelines, of which 37 common carrier pipelines form the analytical scope and 27 can be represented as nodes and edges. Every variable is tagged as taken from the register, derived from GIS or derived analytically, so reconstructed values cannot be mistaken for printed ones. The package ships 215 automated validation checks, 52 mutation tests with a re-runnable harness, and five closure proofs that reproduce subtotals printed in the register; the register and the GeoNames gazetteer are not redistributed but are fetched and checked by SHA-256 by scripts. Version 2.0.1 of 25 September 2026 documents every column in a data dictionary with a validator. Data are available for free download under CC BY 4.0 and code under MIT, from Zenodo and GitHub. Coverage is India. Caveats: node-edge topology exists for 27 of 99 pipelines, geometry is reconstructed, not surveyed, and the release is very recent with several versions in September 2026. Simulation uses are transmission topology and capacities for Indian gas network flow and security of supply models. Related records: data-gem-global-gas-infrastructure-tracker offers global pipeline data.
